description: This PHP source file defines the 'FilterField' class, an entity representing filter field data within the OrangeHRM system. It includes ORM mapping annotations for database persistence, properties for filter attributes, and methods for property access and manipulation.

classes.name: FilterField
classes.description: An ORM entity class representing a filter field in the OrangeHRM system, with properties for filter attributes, relationships, and methods for data access.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the filter field.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the filter field.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the filter field.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the filter field.

methods.name: getWhereClausePart
methods.description: Returns the SQL where clause part associated with this filter field.

methods.name: setWhereClausePart
methods.description: Sets the SQL where clause part.

methods.name: getFilterFieldWidget
methods.description: Returns the widget type for the filter field, if any.

methods.name: setFilterFieldWidget
methods.description: Sets the widget type for the filter field.

methods.name: getConditionNo
methods.description: Returns the condition number associated with the filter.

methods.name: isRequired
methods.description: Returns whether this filter field is marked as required.

methods.name: setRequired
methods.description: Sets whether the filter field is required.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name associated with the filter field.
